Email

alhassan.mu@gmail.com

When you write, tell us your iPhone model, the app version (Settings › About) and what you expected to happen. A screenshot helps. Please never send passwords or full card numbers.

Subscriptions

  • Cancel: on your iPhone, Settings › your name › Subscriptions › Metrado, or open apps.apple.com/account/subscriptions.
  • Restore a purchase: in the app, open the plan screen and choose Restore purchases.
  • Refunds: Apple handles refunds at reportaproblem.apple.com. We can help you with the request.
  • Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Your data

  • Delete: there is no account. Your data is on your phone: Settings › Data › Delete all data. See the data deletion page.
  • Privacy questions: alhassan.mu@gmail.com, or read the privacy policy.

Proposal links and check codes

If a client cannot open a proposal link, ask them to open it in their phone's browser, or send the PDF instead. To check a document before paying, see how to check a document.
